meta.defaultTitle: BajGo — Safar iyo dirid Bajaaj ah oo Garoowe ah
meta.defaultDescription: BajGo waa app-ka Bajaajta ee Garoowe ee safarka iyo dirista alaabta. Ku dalbo Bajaaj ama dir xirmo dhowr taabasho, arag lacagta ka hor intaadan bixin, oo si toos ah ula soco darawalkaaga.

footer.socialNote: Magacyada baraha bulshada waa kuwo ku-meel-gaar ah ilaa akoonnada la furo.
footer.rights: © 2026 BajGo. Xuquuqda oo dhan way dhowran tahay.
footer.tagline: Safar iyo dirid Bajaaj ah oo Garoowe ah.

common.draftBannerTitle: Qabyo — waxaa dib u eegi doona qareen
common.draftBannerBody: Qoraalkani waa qabyo-qoraalka ugu horreeya, weli qareen dib uma eegin. Wuu isbeddeli karaa ka hor bilowga adeegga.
common.placeholderNote: Waxyaabaha ku jira [laba-jibaarka] waa meelo ku-meel-gaar ah oo BajGo xaqiijin doono.
common.lastUpdated: Markii ugu dambeysay ee la cusboonaysiiyay

fare.title: Qiimaha ka hor intaadan bixin
fare.intro: Qor masaafada oo arag inta uu safarku kugu kacayo. App-ka dhexdiisa qiimaha saxda ah ayaa lagu tusayaa ka hor intaadan xaqiijin.
fare.minimumApplied: Qiimaha ugu yar ayaa la adeegsaday
fare.localNote: Qiyaas ku salaysan qiimaha bilowga ee BajGo: $0.50 kiiloomitirkii, ugu yaraan $1.00, kor loogu wareejiyo 10 senti. App-ku wuxuu ku tusayaa qiimaha saxda ah ee waddadaada ka hor intaadan xaqiijin.
fare.liveNote: Qiimo ka yimid adeegga qiimaynta BajGo oo ku salaysan masaafo toos ah oo dhererkan ah. Qiimaha app-ka wuxuu adeegsadaa masaafada dhabta ah ee waddada.
fare.offlineNote: Adeegga qiimaynta lama gaari karin, sidaa darteed tani waa qiyaas maxalli ah.
fare.invalid: Geli masaafo u dhexeysa 0.1 iyo 50 km.

download.comingSoon: Xiriirinta waxay shaqayn doontaa marka app-yada la daabaco.
download.scanBody: Kamaradda taleefanka ku toosi koodhka si aad u furto bogga soo dejinta.

forms.phoneHint: Lambar Soomaali ah oo ka bilaabma +252, tusaale +252 90 123 4567
forms.subject: Mawduuca
forms.invalidPhone: Geli lambar Soomaali ah oo sax ah oo ka bilaabma +252.
forms.invalidEmail: Geli cinwaan iimayl oo sax ah.
forms.tooShort: Fadlan wax yar oo dheeraad ah qor.
forms.consent: Waxaan oggolahay in BajGo ila soo xiriiro codsigan oo ay xogtayda u kaydiso sida ku qoran siyaasadda asturnaanta.
forms.consentRequired: Fadlan oggolow si aad u sii wadato.
forms.contactSuccessBody: Kooxdayadu waxay kuugu jawaabi doontaa taleefan ama iimayl sida ugu dhakhsaha badan.
forms.localModeTitle: Si maxalli ah ayaa loo kaydiyay (hab tijaabo)
forms.localModeBody: Serverka BajGo weli laguma xirin boggan, sidaa darteed codsigaaga waxaa lagu kaydiyay serverkan oo keliya. Fadlan sidoo kale nagala soo xiriir {email} si aan u hubinno inaan aragno.
forms.errorBody: Codsigaaga lama diri karin. Fadlan hubi xiriirkaaga internetka oo mar kale isku day, ama nagala soo xiriir {email}.

driver.intro: Tani waa isdiiwaangelin hordhac ah. Marka aan helno, xubin ka tirsan kooxda BajGo ayaa ku soo wici doonta si loo qabanqaabiyo hubinta dukumeentiyada Garoowe.
driver.rentBajaaj: Haa, mid qof kale leeyahay ayaan wadaa
driver.hasLicence: Waxaan haystaa shati wadis oo shaqeynaya
driver.area: Xaafadda Garoowe ee aad badanaa ka shaqeyso
driver.note: Wax kale oo aan ogaan lahayn?
driver.reviewIntro: Hubi xogtaada ka hor intaadan dirin.
driver.successBody: Mahadsanid, {name}. Waxaan soo wici doonnaa {phone} si aan u qabanqaabino tallaabada xigta. Diyaari aqoonsigaaga, shatigaaga iyo dukumeentiyada Bajaajka.

coverage.title: Meesha BajGo ka shaqeeyo
coverage.note: Aagga midabaysan waa aagga adeegga BajGo ee hadda Garoowe. Wuu ballaaran doonaa marka darawallo badan nagu soo biiraan.
coverage.placeholder: Aagga adeegga bilowga — xuduudda waa la hagaajin doonaa ka hor bilowga.

trip.title: Safar lagula wadaagay
trip.notFoundBody: Xiriirintu waxay noqon kartaa mid dhacday, ama safarku wuu dhammaaday. Weydii qofka kula wadaagay inuu kuu soo diro xiriirin cusub.
trip.demoNote: Safar tijaabo ah — xog tusaale ah ayaa la tusayaa maadaama API-ga BajGo aan la xirin.

notFound.title: Boggan lama helin
notFound.body: Bogga aad raadinayso ma jiro ama waa la beddelay.

pricing.note: Qiimaha waxaa go'aamiya BajGo, wuuna isbeddeli karaa. Qiimaha saxda ah ee safarkaaga waxaa mar walba lagu tusayaa app-ka ka hor intaadan xaqiijin.
